ArtifactMetadata.Summary: Implementation plan for adding a subtract function to src/app.js

args.Content:
# Implementation Plan: Add `subtract` function to `src/app.js`

## Goal Description
Add an exported `subtract` function to [app.js](file:///Users/dev/project/src/app.js) alongside the existing `add` function to perform subtraction of two numbers.

## User Review Required
> [!NOTE]
> Standard export format `export const subtract = (a, b) => a - b;` matching the existing arrow-function style of `add`.

## Proposed Changes

### Core Logic

#### [MODIFY] [app.js](file:///Users/dev/project/src/app.js)
Add the `subtract` function definition and export:

```javascript
export const add = (a, b) => a + b
export const subtract = (a, b) => a - b
```

## Verification Plan

### Automated Tests
Run node check to verify syntax:
```bash
node -c src/app.js
```

### Manual Verification
Inspect [app.js](file:///Users/dev/project/src/app.js) to confirm both functions are properly defined and exported.
